rule: Find the 3x3 tank (a ring of 3s around a 2). Run a 4-connected BFS from all nine tank cells through every non-6 cell; 9s are passable. Take the reachable 9s nearest first, at most nine of them. Erase each taken 9 to 7, then paint that many tank cells 9 in reading order. The centre 2 is the fifth cell.
scope: Construct a capacity-nine 3x3 tank, walls, corridors and collectable items. Select up to nine reachable items by wall-aware shortest-path distance; items are passable. Fill tank in reading order and erase selected items.
constraints: Five original pairs exact; 1000 independent seeds all distinct and solver-exact

authored_scope: Random scenes come in three layouts. Open has no walls. Framed has a gapped or one-side-open 6-ring at Chebyshev distance 2, plus arms, rooms with doors and wall segments. Walled has rooms and segments only. Default sides are 9..16 and may be non-square. Explicit random sides of 7..30 are allowed. Sizes other than 11x11 are synthetic extensions. There are controls for overflow (more than nine reachable), exact num_nines, chokepoint 9s, and a fixed tank position. Explicit scenes (height, width, tank, walls, nines) reconstruct the fixtures. Not supported: other colours, other tank shapes or capacities, multiple tanks, and scenes whose ninth/tenth cut-off is tied.
authored_constraints: Exactly one 3x3 tank lies fully inside the grid; walls and 9s never overlap the tank or each other.
At least one 9 is reachable, so every pair is non-identity.
With more than nine reachable 9s, the ninth and tenth path lengths differ strictly, so the answer is independent of BFS tie order.
Framed gaps are placed only on sides whose outward cell is on the grid; gap and outward cells are protected from later walls.
Walls cover at most half of the grid.
chokepoint=True guarantees a taken 9 that is reachable only through another 9; chokepoint=False forbids that.
Invalid or unconstructible controls raise ValueError, and all retry loops are bounded.
